cards.title: The playing year
cards.text: Typically April through December, with spring and post-league cup options. Two or three 2-hour practices each week.

cards.title: Fall league
cards.text: 10 games: 5 home and 5 away, from late August to mid-November. Teams play cup games in addition to fall league.

cards.title: Age groups
cards.text: Boys and girls, U9 through U19. 7v7 at U9, 9v9 at U11, and 11v11 at U13 and older.

cards.title: Coaching
cards.text: Volunteer head coaches are appointed through an application. Some teams add professional coaches or trainers.

bullets.text: Team selection is by tryouts in January, February or May, depending on age group. Players must attend tryouts.
A second team may form depending on tryout numbers and coach availability.
Teams train longer and usually play 4+ tournaments a year.
Teams typically enter 4–5 tournaments, including at least one overnight travel tournament, such as the Bay Area or Santa Cruz.
Non-CYSA options include sand soccer and small-sided games.
League games are mostly in the Sacramento region, extending north to Chico and south to Modesto.

applyCard.title: Apply and keep learning
applyCard.body: Submit a filled-out application. A Grassroots course for your age group is suggested. Coaches are encouraged to take U.S. Soccer Learning Center courses: the introduction course is free; Grassroots courses are 2 hours and $25, reimbursed by the club once the certificate is received.
